scope: Theorem 5.1 (Quantitative approximation by a long-range attraction) of the manuscript “A radial continuum phase transition with algebraic decay” (preprints/A-radial-continuum-phase-transition-with-algebraic-decay-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 228 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 d53cafa68c322a07), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 16. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix an admissible t and a compact set D ⊂ Ω. There are constants CD,t < ∞ and KD,t < ∞ with the following property. Let R0 ≥ 2, and let φ0 = ψt − t X j αjwRj , 1 ≤ Rj ≤ R0, αj ≥ 0, where the sum may be empty, finite, or countably infinite. If a > 0, P j αj + a ≤ A + 1, and R/R0 ≥ KD,t, then sup λ∈D |Qφ0−tawR (λ) − TaQφ0 (λ)| ≤ CD,t s R0 R . (5.1) Both constants are independent of R0, the number and values of the reference ranges, the reference masses, and the positive mass a.
